method_selection.why: Validation reportedly peaks and then declines, indicating overfit, while node_001's +0.0022 gain is close enough to the seed-noise regime that replication is the highest-priority next step. Train the exact accepted node_001 configuration across 3-5 matched seeds, report individual scores, and per-user rank-average them. This both tests whether the gain is reproducible and offers an honest expected ensemble gain of roughly +0.0004 to +0.001; with 14 iterations left, spending a sub-epsilon step on confirmation is preferable to adding another confounded mechanism. It is also the only available non-measured-dead card whose treatment family does not intersect the excluded overfit/underfit families.

rejected.reason: Although it is the usual follow-up to a tuned package, its treats include overfit, which is excluded by the portfolio policy; it would also introduce more mechanisms before confirming node_001 across seeds.
Its overfit treatment family is excluded, and a broad closing ensemble search is premature with 14 iterations remaining.
The measured FM censored-watch-time auxiliary failed confirmation at 0.6022 and is explicitly measured-dead.
